Name: MapBlink
Author: atudota
Description:
[size=5][b]Map Blink[/b][/size]

Travel with the map you already use. Open the world map, right-click a mapped destination and answer [b]Yes[/b] to "Teleport here?".

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Uses the game's standard world-map position data rather than a hard-coded list of town coordinates.[/*]
[*]Converts your click into a tile within the corresponding location's mapped area.[/*]
[*]Fixed map icons use the center of their associated tile zone.[/*]
[*]Searches nearby for a landing tile, rejecting water, collisions, occupied placement cells and automatic warp tiles.[/*]
[*]Rechecks the destination after confirmation in case something moved.[/*]
[*]Uses the native Yes/No choices; the short question is in English.[/*]
[*]Blocks teleport requests during active events and unsafe player states.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Visited locations[/b]
By default, you can only teleport to locations your farmer has visited; the farm is also available. Set VisitedLocationsOnly to false in config.json if you deliberately want to bypass this restriction. This is a travel cheat, not a replacement for normal game progression checks.

[b]How precise is it?[/b]
The world map is stylized rather than a tile-for-tile minimap. Your click selects an approximate point or an icon's mapped zone; the mod chooses a safe nearby tile. If a location is not represented by usable world-map position data, it cannot be selected. The default safe search extends up to 12 tiles.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 for desktop and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.

[b]Install[/b]
Install SMAPI, extract this mod's install ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods, then launch through SMAPI. Keep the individual mod folder intact. The Nexus images and description files do not belong in Mods.
